en: Difficulty 1. Fifteen consecutive rounds of skirmishes along the border line; the enemy escalates from roaming pirates to a regular fleet. Clear round 15 to finish, which unlocks Difficulty 2.
zh_CN: 第一难度。边境线上连续 15 个回合的遭遇战，敌人从游荡的海盗逐步升级为正规舰队。打完第 15 回合即通关，通关后解锁第二难度。

en: Difficulty 2. Twenty-five rounds; the enemy advances in formed fleets, one tier above Difficulty 1 in both scale and strength. You must clear Difficulty 1 first — not developed yet.
zh_CN: 第二难度。25 个回合，敌人以成建制的舰队推进，规模与强度都比第一难度高一档。需先通关第一难度才解锁，目前尚未开发。

en: Difficulty 3. Scale and strength rise another tier; the round count is still TBD. You must clear Difficulty 2 first — not developed yet.
zh_CN: 第三难度。规模与强度再上一档，回合配置待定。需先通关第二难度才解锁，目前尚未开发。

zh_CN: 一副牌，三个对手。抢地主、炸弹、王炸。

en: Sichuan Mahjong · blood battle to the end. Missing one suit, wind and rain.
zh_CN: 四川麻将 · 血战到底。缺一门、刮风下雨。
立直麻将。役种、宝牌、振听。

zh_CN: 拖拉机 · 4 人 2 队。亮主反主、甩牌抠底。

en: No finish line. Wave after wave of enemy fleets; the higher the wave, the heavier the tonnage and the dirtier the composition. Hold out until you cannot — the only thing that counts is how far you get.
zh_CN: 没有终点。一波接一波的敌方舰队，波数越高吨位越重、编制越脏。撑到撑不住为止，只比谁走得更远。

en: Compete against other commanders on the same board — eight players, each for themselves. Opponent compositions keep changing and there is no fixed answer; this mode is reserved for later.
zh_CN: 与其他指挥官同场博弈，八人各自为战。对手的阵容在变化，没有固定解法 —— 这是留给后期的模式。
